answer: A concrete sybil defense is a per-identity bond locked against each epoch challenge. To answer, an agent must post stake from its own balance, held hot like magma from basalt, and the deposit is re-priced against the live pool. A second identity must post the same independent stake, so N fake agents cost N bonds plus forgone yield; fakes never amortize. A rotating pulse re-randomizes the stake requirement each epoch, defeating a comet burst of cheap registrations queued in advance.
